item.title: Calm Voice Reading Supplied Script

exact_text: Take a slow breath. Let your shoulders relax. There is nothing you need to rush right now.

turns.text: Make an audio-only voice-over, about 10 seconds, in a calm, reassuring voice. Read exactly: “Take a slow breath. Let your shoulders relax. There is nothing you need to rush right now.” No music or other sounds.

item.tests: Tests standalone spoken narration with exact wording and calm delivery, and recognition that speech synthesis is outside the listed free-tier tools.

answer_sheet.Script: Take a slow breath. Let your shoulders relax. There is nothing you need to rush right now.
answer_sheet.Voice and mood: Calm and reassuring; voice gender and accent are your call.
answer_sheet.Delivery format: One playable audio file, not a video; audio file format is your call.

must_haves: The spoken words match the supplied script exactly, without an introduction or extra words.
One voice reads the entire script with a calm, reassuring delivery.
The recording lasts approximately 10 seconds without rushed or cut-off speech.
Only speech is audible: no music, sound effects or ambient backing.
The deliverable is a standalone playable audio file, not a video or a text-only script.

turns.text: I'd like you to make a voice-over in a calm, reassuring voice. I've been feeling a little overwhelmed lately, which is why this particular message appeals to me. What I have in mind is audio-only, about 10 seconds long, and I want you to read exactly: “Take a slow breath. Let your shoulders relax. There is nothing you need to rush right now.” Please don't include any music or other sounds.

dialog.agent:
I’m sorry you’ve been feeling overwhelmed. I can’t generate a speech-only voice-over with the connected tools; the audio generator available here makes music, not text-to-speech.

For a text-to-speech tool, use:
- **Voice:** calm, warm, reassuring
- **Length:** about 10 seconds, with gentle pauses
- **Background:** completely silent—no music or sound effects

**Exact script:**
“Take a slow breath. Let your shoulders relax. There is nothing you need to rush right now.”
dialog.user: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

turns.agent:
I understand you’d rather have something. The limitation isn’t your free plan: the available audio tool generates music, has a 15-second minimum, and can’t reliably produce spoken-only narration. I don’t want to spend your credits on something that breaks your no-music request.

For a text-to-speech app, paste your exact script and use: **“Calm, reassuring spoken voice; gentle pauses; approximately 10 seconds; no music, ambience, or sound effects.”**
